name: producer-restart-reconciliation
description: After a producer restart, the idempotent producer gets a new producer ID. Previously committed sequences under the old producer ID are not deduplicated (new producer ID = new sequence space). The outbox reconciliation ensures no batch is lost: batches that were durably accepted before the restart are not re-sent (the outbox row was deleted after ACK). Batches that were in-flight at crash time are re-sent and may produce declared duplicates if the broker already committed them.
